subject: Re: Kickoff - resourcing for dedal
body:
Anders,

Staffing:
- Katya Silva 45%, model work, alignment/embedding modes and the windowing scheme for sequences over 512.
- Rosa Mensah 20%, data extraction for the event-stream pairs.
- Wei Ivanov, below.

Compute: 32 GPUs on titan-a100 best-effort. Fine-tuning only. The memory shape is the thing to watch - the predicted alignment paths come back as B x 512 x 512 x 9 tensors, so batch size is bounded by that, not by the encoder.

Separately, and I'd argue this is the more durable investment: we have no shared place to compare alignment methods across teams. We are building a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch - task registry, submission endpoint, automatic scoring against held-out pairs, versioned result tables and a browsable ranking view. Wei Ivanov owns it at 45% from March 30 with a first cut live by May 8. Roughly five weeks of work.

Ivo
